title: Appendix A — Proposal
text:
Social Media as News
Authors: Anna-Lies Voorham and Lillie Perez

title: Appendix A — Proposal
text:
Project Description
We will be researching how people, particularly young people, use social media as their main source of news. We want to examine whether young adults’ political knowledge is being affected by their primary source of political information. This matters because a growing number of people rely less on traditional news sources and instead turn to social media for news. Today, there are countless different ways to get political information. I want to see whether people who primarily use traditional news sources have more, less, or the same objective political knowledge as those whose primary news source is social media.

title: Appendix A — Proposal
text:
Research Questions
Our main research questions are:

Are young people more likely to use social media as their main source of news?
Have the rates of people using social media as their main source of news increased over time?
